strategies.name: victory_road_2f
strategies.why: fastest wild spot open post-game without the Sevii story: 40,600 EXP/h, 77 battles and 11 heal trips to MIMIEN Lv 33. The spot is cave floor 3 tiles from the Route 23 exit, out of every trainer's sight; the Indigo Plateau nurse is a walk away (Fly does not work in a cave). Heal every 7 battles is the sim's 77 battles over 11 trips: no HP reader yet

strategies.name: pokemon_tower_5f
strategies.why: fallback: 17,100 EXP/h with the switch trick, healing on the PurifiedZone pad 2 tiles east whenever Blastoise is below full (every battle, with no HP reader). The sim's faster Tower row has MIMIEN fight alone when it outspeeds and surely one-hits, which needs a foe species reader and the grinder's level
